Frontend: logged in as demo@consenso.plus, opened Aria agent → Install tab; verified scriptSnippet contains '/api/widget.js' (not '/widget.js'); btn-copy-script, btn-copy-php (new PHP functions.php snippet), and btn-test-real-page all present; btn-test-real-page href correctly points to /api/widget-test/896e44e0-…/b7e15638-…. Como posso ajudá-lo hoje? Por favor, diga-me qual é a sua questão.' — full end-to-end webchat works. window.ConsensoPlus exposed with open()/close()/tenantId/agentId.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1056 LoC and growing (added widget-test demo HTML inline at 975-1031). Recommend extracting the widget-test demo page into a template file under /app/backend/templates/widget_test.html and loading it via pathlib like widget.html, to keep server.py focused on routing.

widget.js lazy iframe fallback uses setTimeout(8000) — if iframe onload fires after 8s the error box shows alongside a successful chat. Not observed in practice, but consider clearing the timer on successful onload (change: assign timer var, clearTimeout(t) in onload handler).

/api/widget-test/ is a public endpoint with NO rate-limiting or auth — anyone can request it for arbitrary tenant_id/agent_id and will get a working chat instance. That is the intended behaviour for embed testing, but document it as such and consider emitting a 'demo' banner or rate-limiting to discourage abuse.

Legacy /api/integrations PUT + /api/integrations/{id}/test-email endpoints are still live (iteration_4 flagged). Still not removed — consider deprecating or at minimum adding a log warning when called by non-admin tenants.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused demo tenant + Aria agent. The regression test_put_agent_persists_channels_and_email temporarily overwrites channels/email on the Aria agent with TEST_ tokens — cosmetic only, does not impact functional flows (channels remain disabled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four pytest files now: backend_test.py (v2 baseline), test_v2_config.py, test_agent_centric.py (iteration_4), test_widget.py (iteration_5 — this run). Run all: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Key data-testids added this iteration: btn-copy-php, btn-test-real-page (in Install tab of Agentes.jsx). Widget launcher DOM: #cp-launcher (button), #cp-frame (iframe, .cp-open when visible), #cp-err (error box, .cp-open). window.ConsensoPlus API: .open(), .close(), .tenantId, .agentId. The script URL MUST include /api prefix: `${backendUrl}/api/widget.js` — the non-prefixed /widget.js intentionally routes to the frontend SPA (Kubernetes ingress behaviour). Demo test page: GET /api/widget-test/{tenant_id}/{agent_id} returns a full standalone HTML page that loads /api/widget.js same-origin.
rca of the issue: Root cause (from PR): script src pointed at `${backendUrl}/widget.js` without /api prefix → Kubernetes ingress routed to the frontend React server which returned index.html (HTML, not JS). Browsers rejected it as script. Fix applied and verified: (1) Agentes.jsx scriptSnippet now uses `/api/widget.js`; (2) widget.js rewritten with always-visible !important CSS for #cp-launcher, lazy iframe creation on click, cross-domain origin resolution via new URL(script.src).origin, 8s iframe-load fallback error box, and window.ConsensoPlus programmatic API; (3) /api/widget-test/{tid}/{aid} demo page lets the user preview the embed before distributing. Tested: backend returns correct content-type + CORS, launcher is visible, click opens iframe, AI replies correctly. No regressions in agent-centric features from iteration_4.
